notes: No ground truth exists for real detections: rates are APPARENT per-window exceedance rates at the deployed Pfa=1e-3 thresholds, not probabilities of detection.
Secondary windows come from cells +/-1..4 of the target cell; the target may leak into guard-adjacent cells (published guard cells), which biases the ANMF covariance conservatively.

Target cells: literature-verified where a published table exists; the project's statistical inference (D7) agrees with the argmax in most files; 19931111/19931118/1998 files have no published table and are excluded from this experiment.
Thresholds are extrapolated for both detectors (n=4000 pools); the real-data rates inherit that regime caveat.
